user_query: I'm planning a road trip with my friends next month and we want to have a great music playlist. Can you recommend the greatest hot 100 singles of all time? Additionally, provide me with the lyrics of the top 3 songs from that list.

TaskList.description: Retrieve the list of the greatest Hot 100 singles of all time.
Extract the top 3 songs from the list retrieved in step 1.
Fetch the lyrics for each of the top 3 songs identified in step 2.
